finding.summary: Static-SSR field registry creation performs two property-bag probes on a miss.
finding.explanation: GetOrCreate first calls EditContext.Properties.TryGetValue with the registry Type key, then stores through the indexer when absent. EditContextProperties is backed by a Dictionary, so the miss path hashes and probes the same key twice for each form registry creation. A semantic get-or-add operation would need to preserve the property bag abstraction and avoid introducing a public API solely for this internal optimization.
